Hi Irene (and Camila),

Quick heads-up — we tried to hit the sandbox link you shared this morning but Finnect's SRE team can't get a console session past authentication. They see 403s when they try to open the environment (testing from a US-east IP).

Because of that, we'd like to reschedule the console walkthrough/demo originally planned for tomorrow.

Can you do any of the following next week (PT)?
- Tue 5/25 10:00am–11:00am
- Wed 5/26 9:00am–10:00am
- Thu 5/27 1:00pm–2:00pm

Also: could you send a short preflight checklist for our IT (firewall rules, IP allowlist, test account creation) so our SREs can validate before the call? I copied our infrastructure lead, Alex Turner (alex.turner@finnect.com).

Thanks — sorry for the short notice.

Best,
Marta

Hi Marta — thanks for flagging and for looping Alex in.

Sorry you hit that 403; that usually means the sandbox service is blocking the originating IP. Ben, can you confirm whether our provisioning job completed and whether we have an IP allowlist entry for Finnect's egress range?

For scheduling, we can do Tue 5/25 10:00am PT (we'll allocate a short deep-dive slot and a 30-minute troubleshooting buffer if your SREs need it). If that doesn't work for Alex, Wed 9:00am PT is a good backup.

I've attached a short preflight CSV that lists the common checks your infra team asks for (ports, IPs, test accounts). Please pass that to Alex and let me know once they've had a quick pass.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben to verify sandbox provisioning and IP allowlist (ETA EOD today)
- Finnect to run preflight checklist and reply with pass/fail
- Tentatively book Tue 5/25 10:00am PT (I'll hold the time but will cancel if provisioning isn't complete)

If that works, Alex — feel free to reply with the best contact/Slack channel for SRE coordination.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Alex, can you confirm whether you need any additional details from Redwood (e.g., egress IP ranges or temporary test credentials)? If yes, Ben — can you put those in an email thread to Alex (copying me)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marta

Hi all — I checked the provisioning logs this morning. The sandbox VM stood up successfully, but the final allowlist step for Finnect's CIDR block did not complete due to a small template mismatch (we hadn't captured the /22 range you provided).

What I did:
- Manually added Finnect's /22 egress range to the sandbox allowlist
- Redeployed the auth proxy (this clears the 403 path)
- Kicked off a smoke test (passed from our US-east probe)

Next steps for Finnect:
- Alex, if you can try accessing the sandbox again and confirm (I gave the probe a successful auth), please paste the success timestamp here. If you still see issues, we'll open a remote debugging session.

Attachments: finnect_sow_v2.pdf (SOW stub)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/s/REDWOOD-FINNECT-DN4821

I'll leave the tentative Tue 5/25 10:00am PT hold in place and will cancel if we see any more failures.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
